snippets.title: PostgreSQL Recursive CTE for Hierarchical Trees
snippets.code_content:
WITH RECURSIVE category_tree AS (
  -- Anchor member: root categories
  SELECT 
    id, 
    name, 
    parent_id, 
    1 AS depth, 
    ARRAY[name] AS path_names
  FROM categories
  WHERE parent_id IS NULL

  UNION ALL

  -- Recursive member: child categories
  SELECT 
    c.id, 
    c.name, 
    c.parent_id, 
    ct.depth + 1, 
    ct.path_names || c.name
  FROM categories c
  JOIN category_tree ct ON c.parent_id = ct.id
)
SELECT 
  id, 
  name, 
  depth, 
  array_to_string(path_names, ' > ') AS full_path
FROM category_tree
ORDER BY path_names;
snippets.notes: Efficiently flattens multi-level nested folders, organizational hierarchies, and product taxonomies in a single query.
snippets.summary: Traverses a parent-child relational tree to calculate hierarchy depth and string breadcrumb paths.
snippets.explanation: Uses an anchor SELECT query to find roots followed by UNION ALL joining children recursively until all levels are resolved.
suggested_improvements: Add cycle detection using array containment to prevent infinite loops in damaged graphs.
Create an index on parent_id and id to optimize JOIN performance.

snippets.title: Multi-Stage Production Dockerfile for Node/Next.js
snippets.code_content:
# Build Stage
FROM node:20-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
RUN apk add --no-cache libc6-compat
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
RUN npm run build

# Runner Stage
FROM node:20-alpine AS runner
WORKDIR /app
ENV NODE_ENV=production
RUN addgroup --system --gid 1001 nodejs
RUN adduser --system --uid 1001 nextjs

COPY --from=builder /app/public ./public
COPY --from=builder --chown=nextjs:nodejs /app/.next/standalone ./
COPY --from=builder --chown=nextjs:nodejs /app/.next/static ./.next/static

USER nextjs
EXPOSE 3000
ENV PORT=3000
CMD ["node", "server.js"]
snippets.notes: Optimized minimal image footprint (<120MB) with non-root security compliance and standalone bundle execution.
snippets.summary: Constructs an ultra-lean and secure multi-stage Docker container for Node.js web applications.
snippets.explanation: Separates the build toolchain from the final runner environment, stripping dev dependencies and executing as unprivileged user.
suggested_improvements: Enable Docker BuildKit cache mounts on npm ci directory.
Add a HEALTHCHECK instruction checking the localhost /api/health endpoint.

snippets.title: FastAPI Redis Sliding Window Rate Limiter
snippets.code_content:
import time
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Request, status
import redis.asyncio as redis

app = FastAPI()
redis_client = redis.Redis(host="localhost", port=6379, decode_responses=True)

async def check_rate_limit(client_id: str, limit: int = 60, window_secs: int = 60) -> bool:
    now = time.time()
    key = f"rate_limit:{client_id}"
    pipe = redis_client.pipeline()
    
    # Remove entries older than the window
    pipe.zremrangebyscore(key, 0, now - window_secs)
    # Add current timestamp
    pipe.zadd(key, {str(now): now})
    # Count current requests in window
    pipe.zcard(key)
    # Set expire for cleanup
    pipe.expire(key, window_secs)
    
    _, _, count, _ = await pipe.execute()
    return count <= limit
snippets.notes: Sliding window algorithm prevents burst traffic spikes at boundary edges unlike fixed-window counters.
snippets.summary: Enforces precision sliding window request limits using Redis sorted sets (ZSET) with atomic pipeline execution.
snippets.explanation: Maintains timestamps in a Redis sorted set, purging entries outside the active window to calculate accurate request velocity.
suggested_improvements: Add client IP fallback if X-Forwarded-For is missing.
Return remaining quota and reset timestamp in custom HTTP response headers.

# useDebounceValue Hook

![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.0.0-indigo.svg)
![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-Strict-blue.svg)

A high-performance React hook for throttling fast user inputs, debouncing asynchronous search queries, and avoiding excessive renders.

## Features
- Fully typed with generic parameter `<T>`
- Automatic timer cleanup on unmount
- Zero external runtime dependencies

## Quick Start
```typescript
const debouncedSearch = useDebounceValue(rawQuery, 300);
```
